_spec: Stage 9 expected output. Written from the preflight CONTRACT (scripts/preflight-runtime.sh header: 'OK|WARN|FAIL <check name> - <detail>', exits 1 on any FAIL, 0 with --report) BEFORE this harness was run, per the T-403-round-2 lesson. If the script disagrees with a row here, the script changed behaviour - do not regenerate this file from its output.
_shims: Each scenario is driven against the REAL script with a temp PATH of fake python3/tesseract/node/df shims plus controlled env (PREFLIGHT_ETC_TIMEZONE_FILE, PROSPECTUS_STORE_DIR, ADMIN_API_TOKEN). No VPS access, no network.

all-green.why: a correctly provisioned box: every runtime dependency present, TZ Asia/Kolkata, store dir writable, 10GB free, node 22, token set

missing-pdfplumber.why: python3 present but the pdfplumber module is not installed - the exact silent-extraction-failure class stage 9 exists to catch

missing-tesseract.why: tesseract is OCR-only and degrades rather than breaks extraction, so it is a WARN and MUST NOT fail the deploy (walk step D6: no tesseract on the dev laptop)

wrong-tz.why: TZ=America/New_York - the 5h30m timestamp-skew class (T-327); neither Asia/Kolkata nor a UTC alias

store-dir-missing.why: PROSPECTUS_STORE_DIR points at a directory that does not exist - downloaded prospectuses would have nowhere to land

report-mode-still-reports-failures.why: --report must report every FAIL identically but always exit 0, so a pre-deploy report never aborts the deploy

node-major-mismatch.why: the box runs a Node MAJOR other than the .nvmrc pin (item 23 S1): from 23-S2 the release is BUILT in CI on the pinned major, so a different major on the box runs output it was not built for - FATAL, not a warning. Without this scenario the rename above would pass while the assert itself did nothing.

_input: Each scenario declares its INPUT explicitly (pdfplumber/tesseract present, tz, storeDir, args). The input MUST NOT be derived from the expected verdicts: when it was, flipping a verdict also flipped the shim that produced it and the mutation self-healed (caught by the part-1 mutation check). Fixture in, expectation out - two separate blocks.
